title: Academy application layer contracts (services, authorization, scope, safety, business rules)
maintenance_note: Hand-maintained contract. scripts/validate-wave5-application-contracts.cjs cross-checks every row against app/Domain/Academy (permission matrix, service methods, audit and transaction calls).

conventions.error_type: App\Domain\Academy\AcademyError (reason = AcademyReason constant, context = ids only)
conventions.clock: App\Domain\WaveFour\DomainClock (SELECT UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), sampled after every lock wait

audit.transactional: record() runs inside the business transaction: a failed audit rolls back the business write; a failed business write leaves no audit row
audit.override: an ADMIN_OVERRIDE decision writes the operation row (after_metadata.authority = ADMIN_OVERRIDE) plus a dedicated ACADEMY_ADMIN_OVERRIDE row sharing the correlation id; the reason is mandatory

conventions.authorization_chain: actor -> permission (role_permissions, data_type ACADEMY, action = code) -> institutional scope (user_role_scopes/scopes; the role and the scope of ONE grant are evaluated jointly; include_descendants honoured) -> [active class_instructors assignment of the actor's own Person when required] -> operation
conventions.final_authorization: AcademyRuntime::write re-verifies, with FOR SHARE reads and a fresh decisive clock, exactly the grounds of the provisional decision as the last statement before commit; it can never switch from DIRECT to ADMIN_OVERRIDE
conventions.client_context: class_id / academic_unit_id / unit_id may be claimed by the caller but are only compared with the database-derived target after authorization (CONTEXT_MISMATCH); they never grant authority
conventions.person_resolution: people.id or people.public_id (ULID) only; member numbers are rejected (INVALID_PERSON_REFERENCE); no membership dependency
conventions.child_safety: ChildParticipationSafetyGate (Wave 4) through AcademyChildSafety: lockParticipationCover() early, assertParticipationCover() late; fail closed
conventions.pagination: list operations cap the page size at 100

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-11: initial state + classes.enrollable set from AcademyPolicy
operations.concurrency: exclusive lock on the people row serializes every enrollment of that Person; UNIQUE(person_id,class_id) is the backstop and its 1062 maps to ALREADY_ENROLLED
operations.idempotency: natural (logical key = UNIQUE(person_id,class_id)); no idempotency-key infrastructure

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-11: only APPROVED transitions execute; the approval_targets role sets approved_by
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE + lock_version optimistic check
operations.idempotency: re-sending the same target state is INVALID_TRANSITION (a no-op is not a transition)
operations.note: child-safety cover is required only when the target state is configured as an approval target

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: bounded: page size capped, optional status filter, no PII columns

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: exclusive lock on the classes row (aggregate anchor; the schema has no UNIQUE on class_instructors) then the people row; overlap check under lock
operations.idempotency: natural: an overlapping active assignment converges on ALREADY_ASSIGNED
operations.note: admin override allowed (ACADEMY_ADMIN, reason required, audited); a teacher cannot self-assign

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: classes row FOR UPDATE then assignment row FOR UPDATE
operations.idempotency: ending an ended assignment is INVALID_TRANSITION
operations.note: the row is closed (ends_at, status), never deleted

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: bounded (limit 200)

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: class row share lock
operations.idempotency: none (each call is a new session)
operations.note: event_session_id is nullable; when set, the event owner unit must equal the class academic unit's organizational unit; the lesson must belong to the class's course version

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: session row FOR UPDATE + lock_version
operations.idempotency: a no-op is INVALID_TRANSITION

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: AcademicSessionLocationResolver::effectiveAcademicSessionLocation: explicit event location prevails, else classes.location_id; never copied onto sessions

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE, then the UNIQUE(enrollment_id,class_session_id) row FOR UPDATE
operations.idempotency: natural: same status = UNCHANGED (no write, no audit); a different status = UPDATED with before/after audit
operations.note: minor: consent + guardian cover locked early and re-evaluated late at the decisive clock; academic attendance never writes event_attendance

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: entries processed in enrollment-id order (uniform lock order); all-or-nothing in one transaction
operations.idempotency: natural per entry; at most 200 entries per request

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: bounded pagination

operations.scope_source: every organizational unit of the classes taught from the course version AND of the programs whose curricula list its course; ALL must be covered, none = SCOPE_UNRESOLVED (forCourseVersion/forAssessment)
operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09: max_score/pass_score/max_attempts/weight are NOT NULL columns supplied by the caller; a missing value is POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED; nothing is defaulted
operations.concurrency: course version share lock
operations.idempotency: none (each call creates a definition)
operations.note: only schema-declared technical invariants are validated (decimal shape, pass_score <= max_score, max_attempts >= 1)

operations.scope_source: every organizational unit of the classes taught from the course version AND of the programs whose curricula list its course; ALL must be covered, none = SCOPE_UNRESOLVED (forCourseVersion/forAssessment)
operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: assessment row FOR UPDATE + lock_version
operations.idempotency: strict allow-list of columns (mass assignment is rejected, not ignored)
operations.note: scoring fields are frozen once attempts exist

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09: max_attempts is NOT enforced (value not approved); D-11: assessments.open, enrollments.operational
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE anchors per-enrollment numbering; UNIQUE(assessment_id,enrollment_id,attempt_number) is the backstop (1062 -> ATTEMPT_ALREADY_EXISTS)
operations.idempotency: natural when the caller passes the attempt number it intends to create
operations.note: attempt number = last + 1, assigned by the service in the same transaction as the insert

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-11: approved transitions only; the 'submitted' role sets submitted_at
operations.concurrency: attempt row FOR UPDATE + lock_version
operations.idempotency: a no-op is INVALID_TRANSITION

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-11: assessment_attempts.gradable, grades.initial; the only score bound is the assessment's own max_score
operations.concurrency: attempt row FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(attempt_id,version) backstop -> GRADE_ALREADY_RECORDED
operations.idempotency: natural: a second first-record is GRADE_ALREADY_RECORDED
operations.note: version 1 only

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: attempt row FOR UPDATE + the caller must present expectedVersion; a mismatch is STALE_WRITE and nothing is stored; UNIQUE(attempt_id,version) backstop -> STALE_WRITE
operations.idempotency: append-only versions: a stored score is never updated
operations.note: reason is mandatory; audit carries actor, before (version/score/status) and after

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-11: the grades 'final' role; STATE_POLICY_PENDING until the owners approve the transition
operations.concurrency: attempt row then grade row FOR UPDATE; expectedVersion must equal the latest
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: isolated: never blocks the rest of the layer

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: ACADEMY_GRADES_VIEW in institutional scope; ACADEMY_ASSESS alone cannot read

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09/D-11: records the reported ratio only; progress.initial/completed roles; source_version = policy version
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(enrollment_id,lesson_id) upsert under lock
operations.idempotency: natural upsert
operations.note: cache, not a diploma: never decides completion; the lesson must belong to the enrollment's course version

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(enrollment_id,resource_id) upsert under lock
operations.idempotency: natural upsert
operations.note: the resource must belong to a lesson of the enrollment's course version

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09: course_versions.completion_policy_metadata JSON (criteria grammar only; every value is stored data); D-11: 'completed' role + approved transition
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE + lock_version
operations.idempotency: completing a completed enrollment is INVALID_TRANSITION
operations.note: no automatic completion; a recorded grade alone never completes; a grade only counts once it is in the configured 'final' set

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09: a valid completion policy is required; D-11: enrollments.completed, certificates.initial
operations.concurrency: enrollment row FOR UPDATE serializes per enrollment; certificates rows FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(enrollment_id,version) backstop -> CERTIFICATE_ALREADY_EXISTS
operations.idempotency: natural: an active (non-revoked) certificate makes the second request CERTIFICATE_ALREADY_EXISTS
operations.note: ACADEMY_CERTIFY only (ACADEMY_ASSESS never issues); the token is returned once, only its SHA-256 is stored and it is never audited

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: enrollment row then certificate row FOR UPDATE
operations.idempotency: revoking a revoked certificate is CERTIFICATE_ALREADY_REVOKED
operations.note: sets revoked_at and never deletes; a re-issue is a new version

operations.transaction: read (AcademyRuntime::read: single authorization decision, no transaction, no lock held)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09: final_score is always null (POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED); facts only
operations.concurrency: read-only
operations.idempotency: n/a
operations.note: classes belong to a curriculum through cohorts.curriculum_id; result_status is the stored enrollment status verbatim

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.policy_dependency: D-09/D-11: blocked until transcripts.initial is configured; lines are factual (final_score NULL)
operations.concurrency: people row FOR UPDATE + transcripts FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(person_id,curriculum_id,version) backstop
operations.idempotency: versioned (each issue is a new version)

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: program row FOR UPDATE; UNIQUE(program_id,version) backstop
operations.idempotency: each call is a new version

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: curriculum row FOR UPDATE + lock_version
operations.idempotency: publishing twice is CURRICULUM_ALREADY_PUBLISHED
operations.note: a published curriculum is frozen (C8)

operations.transaction: write (AcademyRuntime::write: one DB transaction, deadlock retry x5, provisional then FINAL authorization before commit)
operations.concurrency: curriculum row FOR UPDATE
operations.idempotency: UNIQUE(curriculum_id,course_id) and UNIQUE(curriculum_id,sequence) backstops

state_catalog.approved_note: No entity state or transition is institutionally approved. config/academy.php ships an empty catalog; every state-dependent operation fails closed (POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED / STATE_POLICY_PENDING / INVALID_TRANSITION). Tests inject SYNTHETIC_* vocabularies exactly like the Wave 4 tests.

proposed_not_executable.enrollments: PENDING -> APPROVED -> ACTIVE -> COMPLETED; PENDING -> REJECTED; ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED -> ACTIVE|WITHDRAWN; ACTIVE -> WITHDRAWN; ACTIVE -> FAILED
proposed_not_executable.classes: DRAFT -> PUBLISHED -> IN_PROGRESS -> CLOSED; PUBLISHED -> CANCELLED
proposed_not_executable.warning: Documentation only. Never read by code; the validator fails if any of these names appears as a string literal in app/Domain/Academy.

policy.d09: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: structure available, institutional values OPEN. 0 hardcoded values. Completion policy = course_versions.completion_policy_metadata (JSON; the criteria grammar lives in AcademicPolicyResolver, every value is stored data). Assessment values are caller-supplied (NOT NULL columns) and are not used as enforcement (attempt limit) because a row cannot tell an approved value from a placeholder.

deviations_from_design.adr0015_matrix: TEACH creates/removes class_instructors and needs no class assignment
deviations_from_design.a2_mission: sections 12 and 22: assigning needs ACADEMY_MANAGE (or an explicit admin override); TEACH is pedagogical and requires an active class assignment
deviations_from_design.applied: A2 mission (later, more specific; it prevents a teacher from self-assigning). Recommend an ADR-0015 addendum.

deviations_from_design.detail: A0 section 8.1 proposed action/data_type values differ from the convention DomainAccess/EventAccess enforce (action = code)
deviations_from_design.applied: action = code, data_type = ACADEMY; documented in permissions[].mapping_note
